data.name: Lock_Screen_Assurance
data.value: The work keeps running and approvals wait until you unlock. Agent Studio never asks for your Windows password. Only Windows verifies you, and the app only receives the result.

data.name: Lock_Settings_Intro
data.value: When Windows Hello confirms it is you, and whether the interface locks by itself when you are not using it.

data.name: Lock_Settings_IdleLabel
data.value: Lock the interface after a time with no activity

data.name: Lock_Settings_IdleExplanation
data.value: After that time without using the keyboard or mouse in Windows, the interface locks. The work keeps running and approvals wait. To unlock, use Windows Hello or, if you do not have it, unlock Windows.

data.name: Lock_Settings_Invalid
data.value: The lock was not saved: “{0}” is not a whole number of minutes between 1 and {1}. Enter a valid number.

data.name: Info_Lock_What
data.value: Windows Hello confirms it is you before important actions, such as delivering changes. The lock hides the interface when you step away. The work keeps running and approvals wait until you unlock.

data.name: Info_Lock_Actions
data.value: Decide whether Windows Hello is also asked in the important approvals. Turn on the automatic lock and choose after how many minutes without activity. Lock the interface yourself from the tray icon. Unlock with Windows Hello or, if you do not have it, by unlocking Windows.
